said.q: Vibrant color is used to brilliant effect in this oil on canvas by the French painter Gustave Cariot. The quaint cityscape, as well as the rollings hills that serve as its backdrop, is rendered in a bold palette with lively brushwork that embodies the mature style of this Post-Impressionist artist.

events.n: among the first he composed in Germany after World War I
events.q: Following World War I, Cariot spent most of his time in Germany, and the present oil is among the first that he composed there.
